description: Org-wide Renovate config for Merkleye. Applied automatically to every repo in the org via Renovate's inherited config -- no per-repo extends needed.
@merkleye/design-tokens lives in GitHub Packages, which rejects anonymous reads even for public packages.
Refresh transitive deps in package-lock.json, not just the ranges in package.json.
GitHub Actions, non-major. Pinned to SHAs by helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests, so most updates arrive here as digest bumps.
GitHub Actions, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.

Merkleye's own reusable workflows are referenced by @main on purpose -- callers are meant to track the templates as they land, so pinning them to a SHA freezes every repo on whatever main happened to be that Monday and turns a one-line template fix into a Renovate PR in every repo of the org. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests above is for third-party actions, where an unpinned mutable ref is a supply-chain risk we do not control; our own org is not that. Regex rather than a glob because Renovate lowercases the package name it matches against (the PR reads merkleye/github-templates) while the workflow files say Merkleye -- a case-sensitive glob would silently never match. pinDigests only, not enabled:false: a repo that has already been pinned should keep getting digest bumps rather than sitting frozen at a stale SHA forever.

Go modules: regenerate go.sum. Renovate rewrites go.mod but only reconciles go.sum when told to, so without gomodTidy a branch lands with go.mod bumped and go.sum stale -- every Go job then fails at module load with 'missing go.sum entry' before a single test runs.
Go modules, non-major.

Go modules, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking. gomodUpdateImportPaths rewrites /vN import paths in .go files, which a major module bump needs. gomodTidy is repeated here because postUpdateOptions from a later matching rule replaces the earlier value rather than merging with it.

Go indirect dependencies, which Renovate skips by default. Go records tool directives as // indirect, so leaving the default in place means the tools themselves are never updated -- merkleye's govulncheck (golang.org/x/vuln) and gotestsum are both tool directives, and a security scanner pinned to an aging version fails quietly. These land in the Go Minor/Go Major groups above rather than as separate PRs, and gomodTidy reconciles go.sum for them.
mise-managed toolchain pins (mise.toml: node), non-major.
mise-managed toolchain pins, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
npm dependencies and devDependencies, non-major.
npm dependencies, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
Container base images (Containerfile, docker-compose*.yml), non-major.
Container base images, major -- reviewed separately since these can be breaking.
The node pin is duplicated in mise.toml and Containerfile -- bump both in one PR. Non-major.
The node pin is duplicated in mise.toml and Containerfile -- bump both in one PR. Major.
React runtime and its types must move together. Non-major.
React runtime and its types must move together. Major.
Vite toolchain -- vite, its react plugin, and vitest share a version surface. Non-major.
Vite toolchain -- vite, its react plugin, and vitest share a version surface. Major.
ESLint stack -- eslint and typescript-eslint break apart. Non-major.
ESLint stack -- eslint and typescript-eslint break apart. Major.

Tailwind core and its vite plugin are released in lockstep. Major.
